buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 25% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 25 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC

Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. MII Purchase preference for CLass-1 bidders shall be applicable for this bid in line with MII policy und er GoI guidelines. 2. PRE-QUALIFYING REQUIREMENT (PQR) PART-A: Work Experience of Bidders/System-Integrators: 1) The bidder shall have experience of similar work/items in any Government / PSUs/Banks/ any Public Lis ted Company during the last eight years from the original date of bid submission, as per the following: a. One order executed for the similar item where executed value is not less than the amount o ₹f 5 3.95 Cr including tax [or ₹43.16 Cr including tax for MSE companies] OR b. Two orders each executed for the similar item where executed value is not less than the amount o f ₹ 40.46 Cr including tax. [or ₹32.37 Cr including tax for MSE companies] OR c. Three orders each executed for the similar item where executed value is not less than the amoun t of ₹ 26.97 Cr including tax [or ₹21.58 Cr including tax for MSE companies] The last date of order execution may fall in the above-mentioned period. Note 1: “Similar Item/Work” type means any works/projects which includes supply, installation & commission ing AND system support/maintenance /hiring/deputation of manpower for system support & maintenan ce for the period of one year. The similar item/work should include at least two or more of the following categories: i. Data Management (includes either assimilation & integration of data/data disco very or formation of data lake/ data warehouse/data repository) with or without associated har dware. ii. Data Analytics (includes analytics, reporting and dashboard functions) with or wit hout associated hardware. iii. Business Intelligence with or without associated hardware. iv. Data Science and Artificial Intelligence-Machine Learning (includes either impleme ntation of predictive analytics or machine learning or artificial intelligence) with or without ass ociated hardware. Note 2: i. To arrive at the executed value towards meeting the same or similar work criter ion, the CUMULATIVE value pertaining to above stated component will only be included and ot her items (non-related software & hardware) would be excluded. ii. Bidder should submit copies of Work Order/Purchase order against above work e xperience AND corresponding Completion certificate(s) from the client for the work inter alia in dicating final executed amount and date of completion or any other document, authenticated by the client, containing relevant information to conclusively establish that the bidder has com pleted the requisite work(s) as per the requirement specified above. 2) Bidder shall be an Authorized Business Partner/System Integrator of OEMs involved in the proposed solut ion/system. The bidder shall submit OEM authorization certificate and a back‐end support agreement/arran gement along with the bid for proposed solution support and services with the Original Equipment Manufact

urers (OEMs) for the entire duration of contract. Prescribed format is as given under Volume-III. 3) Financial Position I. MAAT Requirement: The Minimum Average Annual Turnover (MAAT) of the bidder for best three (03 )financial years out of last five (05) financial years shall be at least ₹79.60 Crores (Relaxation in Annual Turnover by 20% (i.e. ₹ 63.68 Crores) shall be considered for MSME & Start-Up bidders as per GoI guidelines. In that c ase bidder has to submit the MSME registration/Start-up certificate along with the bid and should be mandatorily registered on GeM portal as MSME bidder (as per GeM guidelines) to avail the relaxation) . [In case the date of constitution/incorporation of the bidder is less than 3-year-old, the average turno ver in respect of the completed financial years after the date of constitution shall be considered for t hese criteria.] II. Net Worth Bidder should have positive net worth and should be profitable during each of the last three financial y ears. [In case the date of constitution/incorporation of the bidder is less than 3-year-old, the Net worth i n respect of the completed financial years after the date of constitution shall be considered for these criteria.] III. Liquid Asset Requirement The Liquid asset requirement of the firm would be₹ 13.27 Crores, as on the date of original Bid s ubmission. Relaxation in Annual Turnover by 20% (i.e. ₹ 10.61 Crores shall be considered for MS ME & Start-Up bidders as per GoI guidelines. PART-B: Work Experience of Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs): 1) The proposed OEM(s) of the Data Analytics Software & Data Warehouse Software should have work experience either directly or through dealer/System Integrator for the Supply of respective software (s) and the supplied software(s) should be operational for one year in at least two projects in any Governm ent/PSU/Banks/any Public Listed Company in last eight (08) years, from the date of original Bid submission . 2) Proposed OEM of HCI should have work experience either directly or through dealer/System Integrator should have supplied HCI and the supplied HCI should have been operational for on eyear in at least two pr ojects in Government/PSUs/Banks/Public Listed Company in last eight (08) years. Note: Documentary evidence for Sl. 1 & 2 shall be submitted by bidder as copy of Purchase Order/Work Or der/Contract copy/Agreement/Customer confirmation and corresponding Completion certificate(s) of OEM f rom the client for the work inter alia indicating final executed amount and date of completion or any other document, authenticated by the client, containing relevant information to conclusively establish that the bi dder has completed the requisite work(s) as per the requirement specified above. 3) OEM or Authorized Seller of OEM should have a registered office in India to provide after sale sservice support in India. The certificate to this effect should be submitted.

PART-C: General Requirements and Information: 1) Following document shall be submitted by the bidder: a) Copy of PAN Card b) Copy of Partnership Deed/ Affidavit for Proprietorship/ Company MoA & AoA or Certificate of Incorpora tion, as applicable. c) Copy of GST registration. 2) In case bidder/OEM is a holding company, the technical and financial experience referred to herein abo ve shall be that of holding company only (i.e. excluding its subsidiary/group companies). In case bidder/OE M is a subsidiary of a holding company, the experiences shall be of that subsidiary company only (i.e., exclu ding its holding company). 3) Indian suppliers of this item are not allowed to participate and/ or compete in procurement by some fo reign governments. Bidders / products from such countries are not eligible / not allowed to participate in thi s bid in terms of clause 10 (d) of Public Procurement (Preference to Make in India) Order, 2017. 4) Notwithstanding any other condition/provision in the tender documents, bidders are required to submit complete documents pertaining to the pre-qualification criteria (PQC) along with their offer. Failure to meet the PQC will render the bid to be summarily rejected. 5) Owner reserves the right to relax/waive-off minor deviations with respect to QR as stipulated above, th e decision of Owner in this regard shall be final & binding on bidders. 6) Cut-off date for all the requirements shall be considered as original Bid submission date not the extend ed Bid submission date. 7) The Employer may assess the bidder’s capacity and capability to successfully execute the packages co pe within the stipulated completion period. The assessment shall include: i. Document verification ii. Bidders work/manufacturing facilities visit iii. Details of work executed, works in hand, anticipated in future & the balanced capacity a vailable for the present scope of work iv. Details of Technical Expertise and Technical Manpower and Financial resources v. Details of quality systems in place vi. Past-experience and performance vii. Customer feedback viii. Banker’s feedback etc.

3. Due to limitations of GeM portal, the contents of bid document have been uploaded at different sections of GeM portal as under: S. No. GeM Section Contents of Bid document 1. Scope of Work Volume-II: Technical Specifications 2. Payment Terms Volume-I: Conditions of Contract Section IV General Conditions of Cont ract (GCC) Section V Special Conditions of Cont ract (SCC) 3. Pre-Qualification Criteria Annexure-A (BDS) 4. Instructions To Bidder Volume-I: Conditions of Contract Section I Invitation for Bids (IFB) Section II Instructions to Bidders (IT B) Section III Bid Data Sheet (BDS) alon g with Annexures 5. Additional Document 1 Volume-III: Bid Form & Attachments 6. Financial Bid Supporting Doc Volume-III: Price Schedules ument indicating Price Break- up .
